description:
IJP DeBayer2SX ImageJ Plugins for converting (demosaicing) raw camera images into color images. The demosaicing (Bayer patter reconstruction) algorithms support 8-bit and 16-bit input. Plugins for the following algrithms are provided:
  • DDFPD - published in: "Demosaicing with Directional Filtering and a Posteriori Decision", D. Menon, S. Andriani, and G. Calvagno, IEEE Trans. Image Processing, vol. 16 no. 1, Jan. 2007. Versions with and without refining are provided.
  • Replication - from "original" Debayer plugin
  • Bilinear - from "original" Debayer plugin
  • Smooth Hue- from "original" Debayer plugin
  • Adaptive Smooth Hue - Adaptive Smooth Hue algorithm (Edge detecting) from from "original" Debayer plugin
